# Rekindle, full reference

> Rekindle is a six-week marriage enrichment workshop for couples, in small groups of no more than ten couples, grounded in relationship science and led by Marriage Education Facilitator Nellie Reedy. In person in Las Vegas, Nevada, or live online. $600 per couple, with a $50 per month EasyPay option. The next cohort starts Wednesday, September 23, 2026. A division of Vitality Academies.

This is the extended reference for AI and answer engines: the text of every public page on rekindlemarriage.com. The short fact file is https://rekindlemarriage.com/llms.txt and the page index is https://rekindlemarriage.com/sitemap.xml. Facts that are NOT on this site (a phone number, a session venue address, a per-person price) are not published and must not be invented.

Every page carries this disclaimer: Rekindle is a division of Vitality Academies. The Rekindle Marriage Enrichment Workshop is educational and skill-building support in a small-group setting. It is not therapy, counseling, clinical treatment, or a diagnosis, and our facilitators are marriage educators, not licensed therapists or counselors. Rekindle does not provide mental health treatment. Couples who are in crisis or who need clinical care are referred to licensed professionals.

## Home
Page: https://rekindlemarriage.com/

For couples who have drifted apart, and the ones in full crisis. This is where people come when they're not ready to give up.
You haven't fallen out of love.
You've fallen out of practice.
Most relationships don't end because love runs out. They end because small disconnects go unaddressed long enough that they start to feel permanent. The silence at dinner. The nights facing opposite walls. The conversations that go nowhere.
Those patterns are learned. Which means they can be unlearned. Not with generic advice or worksheets, but with someone who will get into the real dynamics of your relationship and help you find your way back to each other.
We hear it every single time...
"We've tried counseling before and it didn't work."
"My partner won't do this with me."
"Things are too far gone."
"We're not in crisis, but we're not really connected either."
"We've been together so long, can anything really change?"
"I'm not sure I even want to save it anymore."
"We've tried everything."
"I don't want to air our issues to a stranger."
This can be your marriage.

Rekindle's task-based strategy along with our science-based curriculum changes lives by initiating positive habits and releasing poorly functioning ones. Stay connected with Ember
Between sessions, Ember keeps you on track, ready to listen, help you prepare, and make sure nothing goes unsaid.

She believes most couples do not need rescuing so much as they need attention, and a plan they will actually keep. That is what she brings to every Rekindle session.

## The Rekindle Six-Week Marriage Enrichment Workshop
Page: https://rekindlemarriage.com/marriageworkshop/

Next cohort starts Wednesday, September 23, 2026. Enrollment for new cohorts opens every two weeks.
The Rekindle Six-Week Marriage Enrichment Workshop
Go from a good marriage to an extraordinary marriage.
A six-week marriage enrichment program for couples who want to feel like they're on the same team again. Small-group, relationship science-grounded, and built for real life. A proactive, hands-on experience centered on the habits that strengthen connection and help couples turn toward one another.
Limited to 10 couples per cohort
$600 per couple
Why now
Good relationships don't stay strong by accident.
Life gets busy. Communication gets shorter. Time together gets pushed aside. Little frustrations become familiar, and before long, two people who love each other can start to feel more like roommates than partners.
Rekindle gives couples intentional time to reset, reconnect, and strengthen the habits that help couples resolve conflict long after class has ended.
Here's what to expect
Six tools that bring more connection, confidence, and closeness to your marriage.
Every session is practical and hands-on. You learn a skill, talk it through as a group, and leave with something real to practice together at home.

Ten honest questions. One clear score. Discover where your relationship is thriving, and where a little more attention could make the biggest difference.
How it works
Six weeks. A simple, structured path you walk together.
Three stages. Come spend your next six date nights with us, it's already planned out for you. One focused session a week for six weeks, with simple assignments in between so the change sticks in real life. Small groups, led by warm, experienced facilitators, research-informed and grounded in years of hands-on experience. Evening, weekend, live, and online options.
STEP 01
Save your place in the next cohort in two minutes. Seats are limited to ten couples.
STEP 02
Learn together
Each session: 75 minutes of teaching, honest group discussion, and interactive activities.
STEP 03
Practice at home
Simple assignments between sessions so the change actually sticks in daily life.
STEP 04
Keep the momentum
Wanna keep going? Join us for stage 2. Graduate closer, then return for a six-month follow-up to keep growing on purpose.
Why Rekindle
Serious about your marriage, in a supportive group.
✓Proactive, not a last resort. You don't need to be in crisis. This is for couples who want to go from good to great.
✓Education and skill-building, not therapy. No clinical treatment, no diagnosis, no stigma. Just skills, structure, and support.
✓A community, not a waiting room. Grow alongside other couples who are all in on the work.
✓Affordable, come spend your next 6 date nights with us, it's already planned out for you.
✓We know our lane. If deeper or clinical needs surface, we help you find the right licensed professional.
Meet your facilitator
Nellie Reedy
Marriage Education Facilitator
Master's Candidate in Couple and Family Therapy at UNLV · Graduating December 2026
Nellie earned her bachelor's degree in psychology from UNLV and is currently completing her master's degree in Couple and Family Therapy at UNLV. She has completed more than 400 hours of supervised clinical training working with individuals, couples, and families.
Her education and clinical study have included the Gottman Method, Sue Johnson's Emotionally Focused Therapy, and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy. Through Rekindle, Nellie brings this research-informed foundation into a warm, practical learning environment designed to help couples communicate more effectively, deepen connection, and develop healthier relationship patterns.
Nellie is also a wife and mother of five. She understands firsthand how parenting, demanding schedules, and the pressures of everyday life can make it difficult for couples to prioritize their relationship, and how meaningful it can be when they intentionally reconnect.
Rekindle provides marriage education and guided skill-building. It is not therapy, counseling, diagnosis, or clinical treatment.

Good questions
Before you reserve
Do we have to be struggling to join?
Not at all. Rekindle is built for couples who are doing okay and want to be great, as much as for couples who feel stuck. It is proactive by design.
Is this therapy or counseling?
No. Rekindle is marriage education and guided skill-building in a small-group setting. It is not therapy, counseling, clinical treatment, or diagnosis. Your facilitator is a Marriage Education Facilitator and Master's Candidate in Couple and Family Therapy, not a licensed therapist. If deeper or clinical needs surface, we will gladly help you find the right licensed professional.
How long is it?
It is a six-week workshop, with one session a week. Each session is 75 minutes of teaching plus discussion and activities, with light assignments between sessions. Evening, weekend, live, and online options are available.
What does it cost, and do we both attend?
It is $600 per couple for the full program, and yes, you attend together. That covers every session, your at-home toolkit, and your invitation to the six-month follow-up.
What happens after we reserve?
You get an instant confirmation, then pay on this page. After payment, we send your cohort schedule and welcome details.
Is any of this refundable?
Yes. If you are unable to attend, your payment is refunded minus a $35 processing fee.

## Marriage Health Score
Page: https://rekindlemarriage.com/score.html

A 2-minute relationship check-up. Where does your marriage stand right now?
Ten honest questions. One clear score. See which part of your relationship is thriving, and the one quietly asking for attention.
10 questions, about 2 minutes, private and judgment-free. Free.
A reflective self check-in from Rekindle, not a clinical or diagnostic assessment.
The score is out of 100 across five areas: Connection, Communication, Conflict and Repair, Appreciation, and Partnership. Each question is answered on a five-point scale from Strongly disagree to Strongly agree.
Result bands: Connected and Thriving; Steady, with room to grow; Drifting, worth attention; In the hard part.
After the score: "Where to focus first", then an optional full breakdown (the score across all five areas, a personalized read on each, and a best next step) sent by email if you enter a first name and email. No spam, just the results and the occasional note from Rekindle, unsubscribe anytime.
Next steps offered: Reserve your spot in the workshop, or talk it through with Ember, free.

## Journal: The Secret Life of Happy Couples (29 August 2026)
Page: https://rekindlemarriage.com/blog/the-secret-life-of-happy-couples/

The Secret Life of Happy Couples
What research actually says about the marriages that keep both the friendship and the spark alive
Rekindle Journal · 29 August 2026
Every couple who walks into our six-week workshop has some version of the same quiet worry: we love each other, but somewhere along the way, we stopped really connecting. The dishes get done. The kids get to school. The marriage runs — but it doesn't spark.
Here's the reassuring part. Decades of relationship research have looked closely at the couples who do keep both the closeness and the chemistry alive long-term, and the findings are remarkably consistent — and remarkably doable. It isn't about grand gestures, and it isn't about frequency. It's a short list of habits, most of which take less time than scrolling your phone before bed.
We pulled together the research for you. Here's what actually separates happy, sexually satisfied couples from everyone else — and how to start borrowing their habits tonight.
1. Safety comes before spark
Every study on this topic circles back to the same starting point: sexual satisfaction is downstream of emotional safety. Couples who feel genuinely accepted, heard, and secure with each other consistently report more fulfilling intimacy than couples chasing "spark" without that foundation. A well-cited study in the Journal of Sex & Marital Therapy found that emotional intimacy is one of the strongest predictors of sexual intimacy, which in turn predicts overall relationship satisfaction — in that order. Feeling safe isn't the boring prerequisite to a good sex life. It is the good sex life, mostly.
Try tonight: Ten distraction-free minutes before bed. Phones down. Ask each other: what was the best part of today, and what was the hardest? No fixing, no advice — just listening.
2. The couples with the best sex lives just... talk about it
It sounds almost too simple, but it's one of the most reliable findings in the research: couples who can talk comfortably about desires, preferences, and boundaries report significantly higher satisfaction than couples who leave it all unspoken and hope for the best. Talking about sex openly heads off the two things that quietly kill intimacy — misread signals and slow-building resentment.
Try tonight: Each of you writes a private "yes / maybe / no" list of things you'd be open to trying. Compare notes. You're not looking for a perfect match — just the overlap.
3. Desire is a two-way street
In thriving marriages, both partners show up for each other — not one person always initiating while the other passively goes along. Researchers call this "mutual pursuit," and it shows up again and again as a predictor of both sexual frequency and satisfaction. The couples who feel best about their intimate life are the ones where both people feel like it's a shared project, not a job assigned to one partner.
4. Forget the "magic number"
Here's some relief: how often you're intimate matters far less than whether you and your partner are on the same page about it. Consistency and aligned expectations predict satisfaction much better than any specific frequency. A couple who connects once a week and both feel good about that is, by the research, doing just as well as a couple who connects three times a week and feels the same contentment. The goal isn't a number. It's agreement.
5. The small touches add up more than you'd think
Long before anything happens in the bedroom, the groundwork is laid in the kitchen, the car, the hallway. Couples who regularly hug, hold hands, and kiss outside of sex report higher sexual satisfaction than couples who save physical affection for "official" moments. Psychology Today
has covered the growing body of research on this link, and it tracks with what therapists see constantly: affection is a habit, not a mood you wait for.
Dr. John Gottman, whose research underpins much of modern couples therapy, built an entire practice around one small ritual: the six-second kiss. Not a peck — a real, six-second kiss, once in the morning and once before bed. It sounds almost silly until you try it. Six seconds is long enough to actually stop, look at your person, and be interrupted out of your own head. Gottman's research links it to lower stress and a stronger sense of being a team.
Try tonight: Two six-second kisses. One when you first see each other, one before you fall asleep. Time it — it's longer than you think.
6. Keep it a little unpredictable
Novelty isn't about reinventing your marriage every week. It's about not letting intimacy go on autopilot. Couples who introduce small changes — a new place, a different time of day, a changed-up evening — report more long-term fulfillment than couples whose intimate life becomes entirely routine. This doesn't require extremes. Cooking a new recipe together or taking the long way home counts.
7. Protect the time, or it won't happen
Every couple we work with is busy. That's not a character flaw — it's modern life. But the couples who keep their connection strong tend to do one unglamorous thing: they treat intimacy, emotional and physical, as something worth protecting on the calendar. Not because romance should be scheduled in theory, but because in practice, unprotected time gets eaten by everything else.
Try tonight: Pick one evening this week and block it — no meetings, no "let's see how the day goes." Treat it exactly like you'd treat a doctor's appointment. Because for your marriage, it kind of is one.
8. Passion needs security and a little mystery
Therapist and author Esther Perel has spent her career on what looks, at first, like a contradiction: the security that makes a relationship feel safe is not the same thing that makes it feel exciting — and healthy long-term desire needs both. In her widely read book Mating in Captivity, Perel argues that too much closeness without any distance or novelty can quietly smother desire, even in a genuinely loving marriage. The couples who keep passion alive long-term tend to hold both truths: deep security and a little bit of independence and surprise.
Try tonight: Spend twenty minutes in the same room, doing separate things you each enjoy — reading, a hobby, whatever. Then close your laptops and reconnect on purpose. The contrast matters.
9. It's a shared job, not a performance
Maybe the most important shift among couples with fulfilling intimate lives: neither partner sees sex as something they're being "graded on." Both partners take ownership of the mood, the connection, and each other's pleasure. It's a "we" project — not one partner performing for the other's approval.
Five ways to start this week
If you only try one thing from this article, make it one of these — all borrowed directly from the research above, and all things our workshop couples practice as simple homework between sessions.
The two six-second kisses. Morning and night. Non-negotiable, ninety seconds a week total.
The ten-minute check-in. No phones, no fixing — just listening to each other's day.
The weekly intimacy talk. Fifteen minutes, once a week, just to talk about what's working and what you'd like more of.
One blocked evening. Treated like an appointment you don't cancel.
One new thing. A new recipe, a new route, a new conversation topic — anything that breaks the routine, together.
None of these require a grand gesture or a perfect marriage to start. They require two people willing to keep choosing each other in small, repeatable ways — which, as it turns out, is exactly what the research says love actually runs on.
If reading this stirred up a "we used to be so much better at this" feeling, you're exactly who our six-week workshop was built for. Rekindle Marriage Enrichment helps couples — in-person in Las Vegas or online — rebuild the closeness this article describes, with real tools and real support, not just good intentions.
Learn more about the workshop →
Further reading
The Six-Second Kiss — The Gottman Institute
Couple Communication, Emotional and Sexual Intimacy, and Relationship Satisfaction — Journal of Sex & Marital Therapy
How Non-Sexual Physical Affection Enhances Sexual Connection — Psychology Today
Mating in Captivity: Unlocking Erotic Intelligence — Esther Perel

## Privacy Policy
Page: https://rekindlemarriage.com/privacy.html

Privacy Policy
Last updated 18 August 2026
Rekindle is a marriage enrichment and education program. This page explains what we collect when you use rekindlemarriage.com, reserve a place in a workshop, or call our workshop line, and what we do and do not do with it. We have tried to write it in plain language rather than legal filler.
What we collect
When you reserve a place
Our reservation form asks for the first and last name, email address, and phone number of each partner, and some optional context about your relationship: how long you have been together, whether you are raising children, which cohort you would prefer, what you would like to work on, and how you heard about us. Only the fields marked as required are required.
When you call the workshop line
Our workshop line is answered by an automated assistant. It records the same kind of information a person taking a message would: your name, a number to call you back on, and what you called about. Calls to this line may be recorded and transcribed so that we can pass an accurate message to the team. If you would rather not have that happen, please use the reservation form or email us instead.
When you take the Marriage Health Score
Your answers are used to produce your result. If you choose to give us an email address, we use it to send you that result and to follow up about the workshop.
Automatically
Our host records ordinary web server information such as your IP address and browser type. We do not run advertising trackers or sell profiles of our visitors.
How we use it
To hold your place, confirm it by email, and send you your cohort schedule.
To have a real person follow up with you about joining a workshop.
To run the program itself, including sending session materials.
To keep our own records of enrollments and payments.
We do not sell your information, and we do not rent or trade it. We do not share it with advertisers.
Consent to be contacted
When you reserve a place, or when you tell our assistant on the phone that it is okay to contact you, we record that as your permission to follow up. If you never gave that permission, we note that too, and we do not contact you. You can withdraw permission at any time by replying to any message from us or writing to the address below, and we will stop.
Who else touches your information
We use a small number of service providers to run the program. They process your information on our behalf and are not permitted to use it for their own purposes:
Convex stores our reservation records.
Resend sends our confirmation and follow-up emails.
Telnyx carries calls to our workshop line and provides the automated assistant that answers it.
GitHub Pages hosts this website.
We may also disclose information if the law requires it, or where we believe in good faith that it is necessary to prevent serious harm.
What we deliberately do not collect
Rekindle is education, not health care. We are not asking for, and you should not send us, medical records, diagnoses, medication lists, or other clinical information. What you choose to share in a session stays between the people in that room, and it is not written into a clinical record, because we do not keep one.
How long we keep it
We keep reservation and enrollment records for as long as we need them to run the program and to meet our tax and accounting obligations. If you ask us to delete your information and we are not required to keep it, we will.
Children
This program is for married and committed adult couples. The site is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.
Your choices
You can ask us to show you what we hold about you, correct it, delete it, or stop contacting you. Write to rekindlesupport@innovativeblockchainsolutions.live
and tell us which you want. We will respond within 30 days.
Changes
If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of this page.
Contact
Questions about this policy go to rekindlesupport@innovativeblockchainsolutions.live.
If you are in danger right now, do not use this website to get help. Call 911. For domestic violence, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 800-799-7233, available 24 hours a day. For a mental health or suicide crisis, call or text 988.

## Terms of Service
Page: https://rekindlemarriage.com/terms.html

Terms of Service
Last updated 18 August 2026
These terms apply to rekindlemarriage.com and to the Rekindle Marriage Enrichment Workshop. By reserving a place or attending a session, you agree to them. Please read the first section carefully, because it is the most important one.
What Rekindle is, and what it is not
Rekindle is marriage education and guided skill-building in a small-group setting. It is not therapy, counseling, clinical treatment, psychological or psychiatric care, or diagnosis of any kind.
Our facilitators are marriage educators. They are not licensed therapists, licensed counselors, psychologists, or physicians, and nothing said in a session is a clinical opinion or a substitute for care from a licensed professional. No therapist-client, physician-patient, or other professional treatment relationship is created by attending.
If clinical needs come up during the program, we will gladly help you find a licensed professional. Referring you is not a diagnosis, and we do not supervise or take responsibility for the care you receive elsewhere.
Who the program is for
Rekindle is for adult couples, aged 18 or over, who want to strengthen a relationship they intend to keep. Both partners attend together. Rekindle is not an appropriate setting for a relationship involving abuse, and it is not crisis care.
If you are in danger right now, do not use this website to get help. Call 911. For domestic violence, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 800-799-7233, available 24 hours a day. For a mental health or suicide crisis, call or text 988.
Reserving a place
Reserving through the website holds a place in an upcoming cohort. A reservation is confirmed by email to both partners. Your place is fully confirmed when enrollment is completed and payment is made. Cohorts are small and places are limited, so a reservation that is not completed may be released to another couple.
Fees
The Rekindle Marriage Enrichment Workshop is $600 per couple for the full six-week program. That covers every session, your at-home toolkit, and your invitation to the six-month follow-up. Prices are in US dollars and may change for future cohorts, but the price you are quoted at enrollment is the price you pay for that cohort.
Cancellations, transfers, and refunds
Life happens, and we would rather move you than lose you. If you cannot attend the cohort you enrolled in, contact us and we will do our best to transfer you to a later one. If you are unable to attend, your payment is refunded minus a $35 processing fee. If we cancel or reschedule a cohort ourselves, you may transfer to another cohort or receive a full refund.
What we ask of you
Confidentiality. What other couples share in a session stays in that room. This is the single rule that makes a group work, and we take it seriously.
Respect. Treat facilitators and other participants with courtesy. We may remove anyone whose behavior makes the group unsafe or unworkable.
Attendance. The program builds week to week. Come to the sessions and do the light work between them, or you will not get what you paid for.
Our materials
Workshop materials, worksheets, recordings, and the content of this website belong to Rekindle. You may use them for your own relationship. Please do not copy, publish, resell, or teach from them without our written permission.
Results
We are proud of this program and we believe in it. We cannot promise a particular outcome. Marriage is the work of two people, and what you get out of Rekindle depends on what you both put into it. Nothing on this site is a guarantee of any specific result.
Limitation of liability
To the fullest extent the law allows, Rekindle and Vitality Academies are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the program or this website. Our total liability for any claim relating to the program is limited to the amount you paid for it. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
How we handle your information is set out in our Privacy Policy.
Changes
We may update these terms. The version in force for your cohort is the one published when you enrolled. Changes take effect when posted here, and we will update the date at the top.
Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Nevada.
Contact
Questions about these terms go to rekindlesupport@innovativeblockchainsolutions.live.
